name: AI Issue Generator - Self-Explanatory Intelligent Auto-Fix
reconciliationNote: All 16 tasks implemented under src/ai-generator/ and src/commands/. Foundations (T001/T002/T006/T007/T010) plus search adapters (T003-T005), dependency-aware official-docs builder (T016), executors (T008 Ollama / T009 cloud), error recovery (T011), orchestrator (T012), CLI generate-fixes (T013), config/cost (T014), and tests/docs (T015). All modules are dependency-injected and network-free by default; verified via tests/ai-generator/generator.test.js (20/20 passing) and the foundations smoke test. Network/model access is only used when a transport is injected.
description: AI-powered issue resolution system that provides self-explanatory issue descriptions, uses code-analyzer for symbol queries and LINQ-like code analysis, applies line-level fixes, researches solutions online, and validates results with intelligent error recovery
keyFeatures: Line-level code editing (not full file rewrites)
Code-analyzer integration for symbol queries and context
LINQ-style code analysis and pattern matching
Local-first AI execution with cloud fallback
Intelligent error recovery with enhanced context

tasks.name: Self-Explanatory Issue Classifier
tasks.description: Build issue classifier that generates plain English explanations (what is the issue, why it's a problem, what to do) and uses code-analyzer for symbol context analysis

tasks.name: Code Context Analyzer with Symbol Queries
tasks.description: Build intelligent context extraction using code-analyzer's LINQ-like symbol queries for precise analysis and minimal token usage

tasks.name: Documentation Search Engine
tasks.description: Integrate documentation search for official docs (ESLint, TypeScript, Angular, React) with local caching

tasks.name: GitHub Issues Search Integration
tasks.description: Search GitHub issues for similar problems and their solutions from relevant repositories

tasks.name: StackOverflow Search Integration
tasks.description: Search StackOverflow for related questions and accepted answers

tasks.name: Context Aggregator & Summarizer
tasks.description: Aggregate search results, code context, and symbol analysis; deduplicate and summarize within token limits using AQ-SF-005

tasks.name: Self-Explanatory Prompt Builder
tasks.description: Build prompts that clearly explain the issue and expected fix, include code context from code-analyzer, and request line-level edits

tasks.name: Local AI Model Executor (Ollama)
tasks.description: Execute prompts against local AI model (Ollama) with retry logic

tasks.name: Cloud AI Model Executor
tasks.description: Fallback executor for cloud AI models (OpenAI, Anthropic) with enhanced context

tasks.name: Line-Level Code Applicator
tasks.description: Apply AI-generated line-level edits (not full file rewrites) with AST validation using code-analyzer and AQ-SF-001

tasks.name: Error Context Generator & Recovery
tasks.description: Detect errors after fixes, generate enhanced context using code-analyzer (AQ-SF-006), and retry with error-specific solutions

tasks.name: AI Generation Orchestrator
tasks.description: Main orchestrator that coordinates the entire AI issue generation workflow

tasks.name: CLI Integration
tasks.description: Add CLI commands for AI issue generation

tasks.name: Configuration & Cost Monitoring
tasks.description: Configuration system, rate limiting, and cost tracking using AQ-SF-004

tasks.name: Testing & Documentation
tasks.description: Comprehensive testing and documentation for AI Issue Generator

tasks.name: Dependency-Aware Official Documentation Context Builder
tasks.description: Discover the project's real dependencies/frameworks (from package.json and other project references) and search their OFFICIAL documentation, then use all retrieved docs as reference material when building fix context. Search targets are resolved from configurable patterns that map detected dependencies to their official doc sources, so context reflects the libraries the project actually uses.
codeAnalyzerIntegration: query-engine.js for resolving referenced symbols to their source packages
deliverables: Project dependency detector (package.json deps/devDeps, and other project references)
Configurable dependency -> official-docs pattern map (e.g. eslint, typescript, angular, react, express)
Official documentation resolver (reuses DocSearcher / P6-T003 with resolved sources)
Doc-context builder that feeds all retrieved official docs into the ContextAggregator (P6-T006) as reference fragments
Local caching of resolved doc sets (AQ-SF-002)
tasks.notes: Search sources are driven by patterns configurable in the AI-generator config (P6-T014). Network-free by default via injectable transport; without a transport it degrades to offline doc hints like the existing DocSearcher.
